ruleset.summary: Storyteller-system d10 dice pool on the V20 chassis. Pool = Attribute + Ability. Each die meeting or beating the difficulty (default 6, range 6-9) is one success. A 1 subtracts one success. Botch on a roll showing zero successes AND at least one 1. Specialty 10s reroll. Three pools: Rage (frenzy + extra actions + form-shift), Gnosis (Gifts + Rites + Stepping Sideways), Willpower (auto-success + resisting urges). Renown (Glory/Honour/Wisdom) determines Rank. Five forms (Homid/Glabro/Crinos/Hispo/Lupus) modify Physical and Social Attributes.

resolution.poolFormula: Attribute + Ability (+ specialty 10-rerolls when applicable, + Willpower auto-success once/turn, + Gift dice, + Rage extra-action dice). Wound penalty subtracts from pools.

Trivial.description: Trivial for a competent character. Often waived.

Standard.description: W20 default. Average task under normal conditions.

Challenging.description: Pushes a competent Garou; pressure or distraction.

Difficult.description: Few succeed without bonuses or supernatural help.

Nigh-Impossible.description: Heroic; requires Willpower, Gifts, or aid.

attributes.name: Strength
attributes.description: Raw muscle. Lifting, melee damage, brawling pools. Modified by form (Glabro +2, Crinos +4, Hispo +3, Lupus +1).

attributes.name: Dexterity
attributes.description: Agility, hand-eye coordination, attack accuracy, dodging. Modified by form (Crinos +1, Hispo +2, Lupus +2).

attributes.name: Stamina
attributes.description: Endurance, soak, resisting fatigue. Modified by form (Glabro +2, Crinos +3, Hispo +3, Lupus +2).

attributes.name: Charisma
attributes.description: Force of personality, sincere charm, leadership presence.

attributes.name: Manipulation
attributes.description: Deceit, guile, indirect influence. Form penalties to humans (Glabro -2, Crinos -3, Hispo -3, Lupus -3); not vs. Garou or spirits.

attributes.name: Appearance
attributes.description: Beauty / presence. Form penalties to humans (Glabro -1); Crinos APP becomes 0 to humans (Delirium); Hispo/Lupus do not use APP socially with humans.

attributes.name: Perception
attributes.description: Spotting, hearing, noticing details. Hispo/Lupus get -1 to -2 reduction on Perception difficulties (sharper senses).

attributes.name: Wits
attributes.description: Reaction speed, on-the-fly thinking, initiative component.

skills.name: Alertness
skills.description: Talent. Notice danger and details. Usable untrained.

skills.name: Athletics
skills.description: Talent (W20). Climbing, running, jumping, swimming, dodging. Usable untrained.

skills.name: Brawl
skills.description: Talent. Unarmed combat; punches, grapples, claw and bite strikes. Usable untrained.

skills.name: Empathy
skills.description: Talent (W20). Read emotions, sense lies of the heart. Usable untrained.

skills.name: Expression
skills.description: Talent (W20). Communicating ideas, oratory, written prose, Garou tale-telling. Usable untrained.

skills.name: Intimidation
skills.description: Talent (W20). Threats, looming presence, breaking will. Usable untrained.

skills.name: Leadership
skills.description: Talent (W20). Inspiring loyalty, giving orders, rallying a pack. Usable untrained.

skills.name: Primal-Urge
skills.description: Talent (W20-exclusive). The Garou's bestial instinct: form-shifting ease, predator's intuition, sensing the supernatural. Cannot be learned by non-Garou. Usable untrained.

skills.name: Streetwise
skills.description: Talent (W20). Navigating urban underbelly, contacts, fences, gossip. Usable untrained.

skills.name: Subterfuge
skills.description: Talent (W20). Lying, misleading, deflecting questions. Usable untrained.

skills.name: Animal Ken
skills.description: Skill. Handling and reading animals (other than wolves — Garou interpret pack-mates instinctively). Untrained: +1 difficulty.

skills.name: Crafts
skills.description: Skill. Build, repair, and make physical things by hand. Untrained: +1 difficulty.

skills.name: Drive
skills.description: Skill. Operate vehicles under stress. Untrained: +1 difficulty.

skills.name: Etiquette
skills.description: Skill. Manners, protocol — both mortal society and Garou sept hierarchy. Untrained: +1 difficulty.

skills.name: Firearms
skills.description: Skill. Handguns, rifles, automatic weapons. Untrained: +1 difficulty.

skills.name: Larceny
skills.description: Skill. Lock-picking, sleight of hand, B&E, forgery. Untrained: +1 difficulty.

skills.name: Melee
skills.description: Skill. Armed close combat; blades, clubs, klaives, fetish weapons. Untrained: +1 difficulty.

skills.name: Performance
skills.description: Skill. Singing, instrument, acting, dance, story-telling for an audience. Untrained: +1 difficulty.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.description: Skill. Move unseen and unheard. Untrained: +1 difficulty.

skills.name: Survival
skills.description: Skill. Wilderness travel, foraging, weather, tracking. Untrained: +1 difficulty.

skills.name: Academics
skills.description: Knowledge. History, literature, languages, the humanities. Untrained: cannot roll without source material.

skills.name: Computer
skills.description: Knowledge. Software, hardware, networks. Untrained: cannot roll.

skills.name: Enigmas
skills.description: Knowledge (W20-exclusive). Riddles, hidden patterns, spirit-logic. Theurges and Uktena excel. Untrained: cannot roll.

skills.name: Investigation
skills.description: Knowledge. Forensic technique, evidence-handling, deduction. Untrained: cannot roll.

skills.name: Law
skills.description: Knowledge. Statute, precedent, courtroom procedure — mortal law (the Litany lives in Rituals + Honour, not here). Untrained: cannot roll.

skills.name: Medicine
skills.description: Knowledge. Diagnosis, surgery, pharmacology. Untrained: cannot roll.

skills.name: Occult
skills.description: Knowledge. Lore of the supernatural — vampires, mages, ghosts, the Wyrm. Untrained: cannot roll.

skills.name: Rituals
skills.description: Knowledge (W20-exclusive). Knowledge of Garou rites. Sets the ceiling on what level of Rite a Garou may learn or perform: Rituals must equal or exceed the Rite's level. Untrained: cannot roll.

skills.name: Science
skills.description: Knowledge. Physics, chemistry, biology — the natural sciences. Untrained: cannot roll.

skills.name: Technology
skills.description: Knowledge. Engineering, electronics, modern infrastructure. Untrained: cannot roll.

derivedStats.name: Breed
derivedStats.formula: Garou breed — Homid (raised human), Metis (born to two Garou; sterile; bears one Deformity Flaw), or Lupus (raised wolf). Set this manually on character creation; record the chosen breed in the character notes. Breed sets the Garou's starting Gnosis (Homid 1, Metis 3, Lupus 5) and unlocks the corresponding Breed Gift list. Default 1 = placeholder; treat as a text label rather than a numeric stat.

derivedStats.name: Permanent Rage
derivedStats.formula: The character's permanent Rage rating, 1-10. Starting value comes from Auspice: Ragabash 1, Theurge 2, Philodox 3, Galliard 4, Ahroun 5. This is the CAP on the Rage pool shown in the Resources cluster. Adjust this stepper directly when the character spends XP to raise Rage. Temporary Rage refreshes per moon-phase and other triggers (see lorebook).

derivedStats.name: Permanent Gnosis
derivedStats.formula: The character's permanent Gnosis rating, 1-10. Starting value comes from Breed: Homid 1, Metis 3, Lupus 5. CAP on the Gnosis pool. Spent on Gifts, Rites, Stepping Sideways into the Umbra. Each piece of silver carried subtracts 1 from effective Gnosis (one-day cooldown after dropping it).

derivedStats.name: Permanent Willpower
derivedStats.formula: The character's permanent Willpower rating, 1-10. Tribe sets the starting value (3 for most tribes; 4 for Bone Gnawers, Children of Gaia, Stargazers, and Wendigo). CAP on the Willpower pool. Refresh: +1 on waking each day; full at end of a story (Storyteller discretion); +1 for fulfilling Nature; +1-3 for exceptional auspice duty.

derivedStats.name: Permanent Glory
derivedStats.formula: Permanent Glory Renown, 0-10. Reflects feats of strength, bravery, victory. Changes only through a Rite of Accomplishment (gain) or Punishment Rite (loss). Galliards and Ahroun favour Glory. See the temporary-Glory counter in Resources for accumulated deeds awaiting the next rite.

derivedStats.name: Permanent Honour
derivedStats.formula: Permanent Honour Renown, 0-10. Reflects duty, ethics, adherence to the Litany. Ragabash and Philodox favour Honour. Frenzying Garou who wake covered in blood usually lose Honour.

derivedStats.name: Permanent Wisdom
derivedStats.formula: Permanent Wisdom Renown, 0-10. Reflects thoughtful action, spirit-world insight, restraint. Theurges favour Wisdom.

derivedStats.name: Rank
derivedStats.formula: Garou social standing, 0-6. 0 Cub (pre-Rite of Passage), 1 Cliath (3 total Renown — earned at Rite of Passage), 2 Fostern (~6 total), 3 Adren (~12 total), 4 Athro (~18 total), 5 Elder (~25+ total), 6 Legend (rare; legendary heroes). A Garou cannot learn or use a Gift above their Rank. Ranks 3+ get +1 to +2 frenzy-resistance difficulty; Rank 5+ requires extra successes to enter frenzy.

derivedStats.name: Health Track
derivedStats.formula: Seven levels (V20 baseline): Bruised(-0), Hurt(-1), Injured(-1), Wounded(-2), Mauled(-2), Crippled(-5), Incapacitated. Penalty in effect = the highest filled box. Bashing heals 1 level/turn automatically; Lethal 1 level/hour; Aggravated 1 level/day with rest. Silver damage is ALWAYS aggravated to Garou and bypasses regeneration. Garou cannot soak aggravated in their BREED form (Homid for Homids, Lupus for Lupus, Crinos for Metis); other forms soak aggravated with Stamina at difficulty 6.

damageTypes.label: B
damageTypes.description: Blunt or non-lethal. Heals automatically 1 level/turn.

damageTypes.label: L
damageTypes.description: Edged, piercing, gunfire. Heals automatically 1 level/hour.

damageTypes.label: A
damageTypes.description: Garou claws/fangs, fire, silver, divine effects. Heals 1 level/day with rest. Silver bypasses Garou regeneration and is unsoakable in breed form.

derivedStats.name: Initiative
derivedStats.formula: Dexterity + Wits + 1d10 each combat round. Wound penalty subtracts from rating, NOT from the d10. Spend Rage in declaration step to gain extra actions (max half permanent Rage rating).

derivedStats.name: Brawl Attack
derivedStats.formula: Dexterity + Brawl. Unarmed / claw / fang attack pool. Bite and claw damage type varies by form: Glabro/Lupus claws are lethal, Crinos/Hispo claws are aggravated to mortals and to other supernaturals.

derivedStats.name: Melee Attack
derivedStats.formula: Dexterity + Melee. Armed close-combat pool (blades, clubs, klaives, fetish weapons). Charms and weapon enhancements modify it.

derivedStats.name: Firearms Attack
derivedStats.formula: Dexterity + Firearms. Ranged attack pool. Range modifiers add +1/+2 difficulty for medium/long range. Silver bullets do aggravated damage to Garou.

derivedStats.name: Soak (Bashing)
derivedStats.formula: Stamina + armour B-soak, rolled at difficulty 6. Soak rolls cannot botch. Garou regenerate 1 bashing level per turn automatically.

derivedStats.name: Soak (Lethal)
derivedStats.formula: Stamina + armour L-soak, rolled at difficulty 6. Garou soak lethal with full Stamina (mortals cannot). Regenerate 1 lethal level per hour automatically.

derivedStats.name: Soak (Aggravated)
derivedStats.formula: Stamina (in non-breed forms only) + supernatural armour, rolled at difficulty 6. Garou CANNOT soak aggravated in their BREED form (Homids in Homid, Lupus in Lupus, Metis in Crinos). Silver damage is unsoakable in breed form and bypasses regeneration entirely. Heals 1 level/day with rest.

values.label: Homid
values.description: Human form. No Attribute modifiers. Full speech, social capability. Default for Homid-breed Garou. Cannot soak aggravated for Homid-breed in this form.

values.label: Glabro
values.description: Near-human form. STR +2, STA +2, MAN -2, APP -1 (humans). Guttural speech possible; teeth lethal damage (Str -1). Often the form for intimidation among humans.

values.label: Crinos
values.description: Wolf-man / war form. STR +4, DEX +1, STA +3, MAN -3, APP 0 (humans witness as Delirium). Fangs and claws inflict AGGRAVATED damage. Cannot speak human languages. Default for Metis-breed. Triggers Delirium in humans who see it.

values.label: Hispo
values.description: Dire-wolf form. STR +3, DEX +2, STA +3, MAN -3, PER -1 difficulty. Extra bite die. Claws aggravated. Cannot manipulate human tools.

values.label: Lupus
values.description: Wolf form. STR +1, DEX +2, STA +2, MAN -3, PER -2 difficulty. 2x movement speed. Claws inflict LETHAL only (aggravated only for Lupus-breed). Default for Lupus-breed. Cannot speak; cannot manipulate human tools.

values.label: Calm
values.description: Beast contained. Normal action and roleplay.

values.label: Rising
values.description: A Rage roll is imminent — surge in fury, eyes flickering. Player or Storyteller can spend Willpower to head off the trigger.

values.label: Berserk Frenzy
values.description: Rage roll scored 4+ successes. Garou shifts to Crinos or Hispo and attacks. If Rage > Gnosis, may attack indiscriminately (including packmates). Cannot use Gifts, pack tactics, or Step Sideways. Spend 1 Willpower to abort.

values.label: Fox Frenzy
values.description: Rage roll scored 4+ in panic. Garou shifts to Lupus and flees at max speed. Attacks only if escape is blocked.

values.label: Thrall of the Wyrm
values.description: Rage roll scored 6+ successes — unbreakable frenzy. Cannot be halted by Willpower. Triggers a breed-specific compulsion: Homid (Eater-of-Souls — consume kills), Metis (Defiler — sexual acts on fallen), Lupus (Beast-of-War — savage the corpse).

values.label: Touched
values.description: Lingering despair, blurred sense of reality between Umbra and physical world. -1 die to social and Willpower rolls until rebalanced.

values.label: Deep Harano
values.description: Severe despair. Lethargy, existential crisis, may refuse to act. Resolution typically requires elder counsel and time in a balanced setting.

values.label: Penumbra
values.description: In the Umbral reflection adjacent to the physical world. Garou see spirits, walk Moon Bridges, can interact with Banes.

values.label: Deep Umbra
values.description: Far Umbra / Aetherial Realm / Wyld zones. Hostile to the unprepared.

diceTagFormat.example: [dice: 8d10 vs 6 -> 4 successes, +1 Willpower auto, 2 specialty rerolls]

Mechanics references only; tribe / auspice / Gift / Rite / totem names belong to Paradox Interactive AB. No verbatim corebook text reproduced. Distributed under the Dark Pack Agreement.

entries.name: Rule: Dice-pool resolution
entries.content:
**Rule: Dice-pool resolution.** W20 = V20 Storyteller chassis applied to werewolves.
- Pool = (Attribute + Ability) + specialty 10-rerolls (trait rated 4+ in scope) + Gift dice + Rage-bought extra-action dice.
- Each die ≥ difficulty = 1 success. Default difficulty 6 (range 6–9).
- 1 cancels one success (Rule of 1). ≥1 net success = action works.
- Spend 1 Willpower for one guaranteed automatic success per turn (NOT on damage rolls or Gift activations).
- Pools are reduced by the current health-track penalty.

entries.name: Rule: Botch
entries.content:
**Rule: Botch.**
- Botch = ZERO net successes AND ≥1 die showing a 1.
- 1s only cause a botch when net successes are zero. Otherwise they just cancel successes one-for-one.
- Storyteller introduces a real complication, not just a miss.

entries.name: Rule: Willpower
entries.content:
**Rule: Willpower.**
- Permanent rating (1–10) + temporary pool (≤ permanent).
- Spend 1 to:
  - gain an automatic success (cap once/turn, not on damage or Gift activations)
  - ignore wound penalty on a single roll
  - abort a triggered frenzy
  - resist instinctive urges (fleeing fire, attacking a Wyrm-creature)
- Regain: +1 on waking each morning · more at story end · on personal victory · for exceptional auspice duty.

entries.name: Rule: Rage
entries.content:
**Rule: Rage.** Gaia's fury — the Beast.
- Permanent rating + temporary pool.
- Spend in declaration step:
  - 1 Rage = 1 extra action (cap = half permanent Rage)
  - 1 Rage = instant form-shift (no roll)
  - 1 Rage = ignore stun for a turn
  - When Incapacitated: Rage roll diff 8, each success heals a level. Once/scene. Leaves a Battle Scar.
- Regain: first moon sighting nightly (new 1, waning 2, half/waxing 3, full 4) · auspice moon = full Rage pool · humiliation · botches · moments before combat.
- **Frenzy**: a Rage roll scoring 4+ successes. 6+ = Thrall of the Wyrm (unbreakable; breed compulsion).
- **Beast Within**: for every Rage point above current Willpower, −1 die on Social rolls.
- **Losing the Wolf**: if both Rage and Willpower pools hit 0, stuck in breed form until Rage returns.

entries.name: Rule: Gnosis
entries.content:
**Rule: Gnosis.** Spirit-world connection.
- Permanent rating + temporary pool (≤ permanent).
- Spent on Gifts, Mystic Rites, attuning fetishes, Stepping Sideways.
- **Stepping Sideways**: see a reflective surface → roll Gnosis vs local Gauntlet.
  - Science lab 9 · urban downtown 8 · city street 7 · rural 6 · deep wild 5 · urban caern 5 · active caern 4 · powerful caern 3 · greatest caerns 2.
  - Successes determine speed: 0 fail · 1 = 5min · 2 = 30sec · 3+ instant. BOTCH = trapped in the Gauntlet.
- **Silver penalty**: each piece of silver carried subtracts 1 from effective Gnosis (1-day cooldown after discard).
- Cannot use Rage AND Gnosis in the same turn (specific Gifts excepted).
- Regain: meditation (Wits + Enigmas vs 8, 1 success = 1 Gnosis, once/day) · Sacred Hunt with Engling at moot (full restore) · spirit bargain · between-stories Cha + Enigmas.
- **Harano**: high-Gnosis despair (Silver Fangs prone). Blurred reality, lethargy, possible inaction.

entries.name: Rule: Renown — Glory, Honour, Wisdom
entries.content:
**Rule: Renown — Glory, Honour, Wisdom.**
- Three categories — currency of standing in the Garou Nation:
  - **Glory** — deeds of strength, bravery, victory. Favoured: Galliards & Ahroun.
  - **Honour** — duty, ethics, Litany adherence. Favoured: Ragabash & Philodox.
  - **Wisdom** — thoughtful action, spirit insight, restraint. Favoured: Theurges.
- Each tracked as permanent dots (slow to change) + temporary pool (no cap; accumulates between rites).
- Permanent gain via Rite of Accomplishment (Cha + Rituals vs 6). Permanent loss via Punishment Rite.

entries.name: Rule: Rank
entries.content:
**Rule: Rank.**
- 0 Cub (pre-Rite of Passage)
- 1 Cliath — 3 total Renown (earned at Rite of Passage)
- 2 Fostern — ~6 total
- 3 Adren — ~12 total
- 4 Athro — ~18 total
- 5 Elder — ~25+ total
- 6 Legend — rare
- A Garou cannot learn or use a Gift above their current Rank.
- Frenzy-resistance bonus: Rank 3 = +1 difficulty · Rank 4 = +2 · Rank 5 = +2 AND requires 5+ Rage successes to enter frenzy · Rank 6 = +2 AND 6+ to frenzy.
- Rank advancement: formal challenge against a Garou one Rank higher.

entries.name: Rule: The Five Forms
entries.content:
**Rule: The Five Forms.** Modifiers stack on the Homid baseline (Metis/Lupus apply them to their own breed-form base).
- **Homid** — no mods · full speech · full human capability.
- **Glabro** — STR +2 · STA +2 · MAN −2 · APP −1 (humans) · guttural speech · lethal teeth (Str−1 damage).
- **Crinos** — STR +4 · DEX +1 · STA +3 · MAN −3 · APP 0 to humans (Delirium) · fangs and claws AGGRAVATED · cannot speak human languages · default for Metis-breed.
- **Hispo** — STR +3 · DEX +2 · STA +3 · MAN −3 · PER difficulty −1 · extra bite die · claws aggravated · cannot use tools.
- **Lupus** — STR +1 · DEX +2 · STA +2 · MAN −3 · PER difficulty −2 · 2× speed · claws lethal only (aggravated only for Lupus-breed in Lupus) · default for Lupus-breed · cannot speak or use tools.
- **Shift roll**: Stamina + Primal-Urge, 1 success per form crossed. Spend 1 Rage to shift instantly (no roll).

entries.name: Rule: Health, soak, and regeneration
entries.content:
**Rule: Health, soak, and regeneration.**
- 7 levels: Bruised(-0) / Hurt(-1) / Injured(-1) / Wounded(-2) / Mauled(-2) / Crippled(-5) / Incapacitated.
- Highest filled level's penalty applies to ALL dice pools.
- **Soak** (difficulty 6, cannot botch, ignores wound penalty):
  - Bashing: Stamina (Garou regen 1 level/turn automatically).
  - Lethal: Stamina (Garou regen 1 level/hour automatically).
  - Aggravated: Stamina ONLY in non-breed forms. In breed form (Homid for Homid-breed, Lupus for Lupus-breed, Crinos for Metis) — NO soak for aggravated. Heals 1 level/day with rest.
- **Silver**: ALWAYS aggravated to Garou. Bypasses regeneration. Unsoakable in breed form. Metis cannot soak silver in ANY form.
- Spend Rage past Incapacitated to keep acting (each Rage = 1 self-inflicted aggravated).

entries.name: Rule: Combat round
entries.content:
**Rule: Combat round.**
- Initiative = Dexterity + Wits + 1d10. Highest first; ties to highest Dex+Wits. Declare in reverse initiative. Wound penalty hits rating, not d10.
- **Rage extra actions** (declaration step): cap = half permanent Rage. Exceed min(Dex, Wits) → +3 difficulty to ALL pools that turn.
- **Split actions without Rage**: −1 die / +1 difficulty cumulative per extra action.
- **Attack pools**: Brawl/claws/fangs = Dex+Brawl · Melee = Dex+Melee · Firearms = Dex+Firearms (range +1 medium / +2 long) · Thrown = Dex+Athletics.
- **Defence**: Dodge (Dex+Athletics) · Block (Dex+Brawl, hand-to-hand) · Parry (Dex+Melee, weapon required).
- **Damage**: attack roll difficulty 6; each success above the first → +1 bonus damage die.
- **Pack tactics** (shared totem): Fur Gnarl (strip armour, 2+ packmates) · Harrying (4+) · Savage (dogpile, 3+).
- **Frenzy in combat**: no Gifts, no pack tactics, no Step Sideways, no splitting — only bite, claw, run. Ignore pain and wound penalties.

entries.name: Rule: Frenzy / Thrall of the Wyrm / Delirium / The Curse
entries.content:
**Rule: Frenzy / Thrall / Delirium / The Curse.**
- **Frenzy trigger**: Rage roll scoring 4+ successes.
  - **Berserk Frenzy**: shift Crinos/Hispo and attack. If Rage > Gnosis, may target packmates.
  - **Fox Frenzy**: shift Lupus and flee. Only attack if cornered.
- Spend 1 Willpower to abort frenzy (lose remaining turn).
- End frenzy: each subsequent turn roll Willpower vs difficulty = permanent Rage.
- **Thrall of the Wyrm** (6+ Rage successes): unbreakable by Willpower. On Wits diff 7 botch the character commits a breed compulsion:
  - Homid → Eater-of-Souls (consume kills)
  - Metis → Defiler (abuse fallen)
  - Lupus → Beast-of-War (destroy the corpse)
- **Delirium**: humans seeing Crinos suffer fear / disbelief / panic / bloodlust by Willpower. The Veil makes most rationalise the memory ('It was a bear'). Willpower 8+ remember clearly. Kinfolk are immune.
- **The Curse**: humans whose Willpower < the Garou's permanent Rage instinctively avoid the Garou — cross streets, end conversations, refuse to hire. Garou cannot live ordinary human lives.

entries.name: Rule: Gifts
entries.content:
**Rule: Gifts.** Spirit-taught powers, levels 1–6.
- Each Gift lists Activation cost (Gnosis / Rage / Willpower, sometimes none), Teaching spirit, and System (which dice roll if any).
- Learned: petition a spirit at a caern of equal-or-higher level than the Gift. Chiminage (offering/service) usually required.
- A Garou cannot LEARN or USE a Gift above their current Rank.
- Cross-list Gifts cost extra XP.
- Level-6 Gifts are legendary — only one or two living Garou know each.

entries.name: Rule: Rites
entries.content:
**Rule: Rites.** Ceremonies, not personal powers.
- Requires Rituals Knowledge ≥ rite level. Most rites require multiple Garou, materials, 10+ min per level.
- Categories:
  - **Accord** — restore harmony, purification (Cha + Rituals vs 7)
  - **Caern** — protect/maintain/open Moon Bridges (varies)
  - **Death** — honour fallen (Cha + Rituals vs 8 − rank of deceased)
  - **Mystic** — Umbral contact/summoning (Wits + Rituals vs 7)
  - **Punishment** — justice (Cha + Rituals vs 7 — failure = Gaia rejects)
  - **Renown** — celebrate accomplishments (Cha + Rituals vs 6)
  - **Seasonal** — renew Gaia connection (Sta + Rituals vs 8 − caern level)
- Theurges and Philodox most often perform rites; any Garou with the right Rituals can.
- Minor rites are daily practices (no roll).

entries.name: Rule: Gauntlet, Umbra, caerns
entries.content:
**Rule: Gauntlet, Umbra, caerns.**
- **Gauntlet difficulty** to Step Sideways (see Gnosis entry for the table).
- **Penumbra** = Umbral reflection of the physical world. Vibrant living things; ghost-outlined new buildings, solid old ones; shadowy/mocking versions of corrupt places. Time and distance roughly match the physical world.
- **Caerns** = Garou sacred places. Pooled Wyld energy; thin Gauntlet. Rated 1–5.
- Caern types grant matching benefits (Healing, Gnosis, Rage, Strength, Stamina, Visions, Wisdom, Wyld, etc.).
- All caerns can open **Moon Bridges** — Umbral pathways to other distant caerns.
- **Septs** = pack communities centred on a caern.
- After ~1 year and 1 day spent only in one realm, the Garou risks severing connection to the other.

entries.name: Rule: The Litany
entries.content:
**Rule: The Litany.** The law that binds all Garou. Major tenets:
- Garou shall not mate with Garou (Metis are the proof of the punishment).
- Combat the Wyrm wherever it breeds and wherever it dwells.
- Respect the territory of another.
- Accept an honourable surrender.
- Submission to those of higher station.
- The first sip of blood goes to the leader.
- Ye shall not eat the flesh of humans.
- Respect those beneath ye — all are of Gaia.
- The Veil shall not be lifted (Crinos before mortals; reveal nothing of Garou existence).
- Do not suffer thy people to tend thy sickness.
- The leader may be challenged at any time during peace.
- The leader may not be challenged during wartime.
- Cleansing of corruption is the right of all.
- Breaking the Litany costs Honour Renown.

entries.name: Rule: Backgrounds
entries.content:
**Rule: Backgrounds.**
- 0–5 dots. Raise in play at current rating × 2 XP per new dot.
- W20 list: Allies · Ancestors · Contacts · Fate · Fetish · Kinfolk · Mentor · Pure Breed · Resources · Rites · Spirit Heritage · Totem.
- **Ancestors**: once/session, roll vs 8; substitute rating in an appropriate Ability roll.
- **Fate**: once/session, add successes to a failed roll.
- **Fetish**: rating = total fetish levels carryable.
- **Kinfolk**: non-Garou relatives, immune to Delirium.
- **Pure Breed**: lineage prestige. Silver Fangs MUST have 3+.
- **Rites**: rating = total rite levels known (must have matching Rituals).
- **Totem**: pack only; points buy abilities.
- Tribal restrictions apply — see per-tribe entries.

entries.name: Lore: The Triat — Wyld, Weaver, Wyrm
entries.content:
**Lore: The Triat — Wyld, Weaver, Wyrm.** Three primal cosmic forces.
- **Wyld** — raw creation, chaos, change. Gave the world fertility and possibility.
- **Weaver** — pattern, order, structure. Gave the world coherence and survival.
- **Wyrm** — originally the destroyer that closed the cycle (death cleared the way for new life). The Weaver's growing madness trapped the Wyrm in webs of order; the Wyrm went mad with pain and now serves entropy and corruption rather than natural endings.
- The Garou fight the corrupt Wyrm and increasingly the rigid Weaver too.
- **Black Spiral Dancers** — corrupted Garou who serve the Wyrm fully.
- Most Garou see **Gaia**, Mother Earth herself, as the wounded balance the Triat once preserved.

entries.name: Breed: Homid
entries.content:
**Breed: Homid.** Raised human, First Change in adolescence (often catastrophically).
- Default form: Homid. Cannot soak aggravated in Homid form.
- Comfortable with technology, urban life, human society — the bridge between Garou and Kinfolk.
- Sample Homid Breed Gifts (Lv 1): City Running · Smell of Man · Persuasion · Master of Fire · Apecraft's Blessings.

entries.name: Breed: Metis
entries.content:
**Breed: Metis.** Born to two Garou parents — a forbidden union under the Litany.
- Sterile.
- Bears one permanent DEFORMITY across all forms (albino, fits of madness, hairless, horns, hunchback, no sense of smell, no tail, seizures, tough hide, wasting disease, weak immune, withered limb, etc.).
- Raised in the sept from birth — never had a normal human or wolf life.
- Default form: Crinos. Cannot soak aggravated in Crinos.
- Sample Metis Breed Gifts (Lv 1): Create Element · Primal Anger · Rat Head · Sense Wyrm · Shed.

entries.name: Breed: Lupus
entries.content:
**Breed: Lupus.** Raised by wolf parents, Changed when their wolf life encountered humans.
- Strongest spirit connection of the three breeds.
- Default form: Lupus. Cannot soak aggravated in Lupus form.
- Struggles with human concepts: cannot begin play with dots in Academics, Computer, Enigmas, Law, or Technology without justification.
- Sample Lupus Breed Gifts (Lv 1): Hare's Leap · Heightened Senses · Predator's Arsenal · Prey Mind · Sense Prey.

entries.name: Auspice: Ragabash (New Moon)
entries.content:
**Auspice: Ragabash (New Moon).** Tricksters, scouts, questioners, gadflies.
- Challenge complacency, scout for the pack, ask the unspoken question.
- Primary Renown: Honour.
- Sample Lv 1 Auspice Gifts: Blur of the Milky Eye · Infectious Laughter · Liar's Face · Open Seal · Scent of Running Water.

entries.name: Auspice: Theurge (Crescent Moon)
entries.content:
**Auspice: Theurge (Crescent Moon).** Seers, mystics, ritemasters, spirit-walkers.
- Speak with spirits, interpret omens, lead Mystic Rites.
- Primary Renown: Wisdom.
- Sample Lv 1 Auspice Gifts: Mother's Touch · Sense Wyrm · Spirit Snare · Spirit Speech · Umbral Tether.

entries.name: Auspice: Philodox (Half Moon)
entries.content:
**Auspice: Philodox (Half Moon).** Judges, mediators, keepers of the Litany.
- Settle disputes, interpret the Litany, lead Punishment Rites.
- Primary Renown: Honour.
- Sample Lv 1 Auspice Gifts: Fangs of Judgment · Persuasion · Resist Pain · Scent of the True Form · Truth of Gaia.

entries.name: Auspice: Galliard (Gibbous Moon)
entries.content:
**Auspice: Galliard (Gibbous Moon).** Bards, storytellers, morale officers, lore-keepers.
- Tell the deeds of the pack, raise pack spirits, lead Rites of Death and Renown.
- Primary Renown: Glory.
- Sample Lv 1 Auspice Gifts: Beast Speech · Call of the Wyld · Heightened Senses · Mindspeak · Perfect Recall.

entries.name: Auspice: Ahroun (Full Moon)
entries.content:
**Auspice: Ahroun (Full Moon).** Warriors, champions, war leaders.
- The pack's spear-tip; the most prone to frenzy.
- Primary Renown: Glory.
- Sample Lv 1 Auspice Gifts: Falling Touch · Inspiration · Pack Tactics · Razor Claws · Spur Claws.

entries.name: Tribes overview (13 + Black Spiral Dancers)
entries.content:
**Tribes overview.** Thirteen tribes of the Garou Nation, each with a totem spirit, starting Willpower (most 3; Bone Gnawers, Children of Gaia, Stargazers, Wendigo at 4), Tribal Gifts, and Background restrictions.
- **Black Furies** (Pegasus) — Wyld-guardians, women's mysteries.
- **Bone Gnawers** (Rat) — urban survivors, dispossessed.
- **Children of Gaia** (Unicorn) — peacemakers, healers.
- **Fianna** (Stag) — Celtic bards, passionate warriors.
- **Get of Fenris** (Fenris) — berserkers, Ragnarok-ready.
- **Glass Walkers** (Cockroach) — urban tech-shamans.
- **Red Talons** (Griffin) — lupus-only, anti-human feral guardians.
- **Shadow Lords** (Grandfather Thunder) — political manipulators.
- **Silent Striders** (Owl) — cursed wanderers, messengers.
- **Silver Fangs** (Falcon) — aristocratic leaders (require Pure Breed 3+).
- **Stargazers** (Chimera) — contemplatives.
- **Uktena** (Uktena) — occultists, Bane Tenders.
- **Wendigo** (Wendigo) — pure hunters.
- **Lost Tribes**: White Howlers (→ Black Spiral Dancers) · Croatan (binding sacrifice) · Bunyip (slaughtered, War of Tears).
- **Black Spiral Dancers** = corrupted Garou serving the Wyrm directly. The Garou Nation's worst enemy.

entries.name: Tribe: Silver Fangs
entries.content:
**Tribe: Silver Fangs (totem: Falcon).** Hereditary aristocrats of the Garou Nation, descended from European royal lineages.
- Starting Willpower 3.
- Required: Pure Breed 3+ at creation.
- Sample tribal Gifts: Falcon's Grasp · Lambent Flame · Sense Wyrm · Sense the Unnatural.
- Many suffer from inbreeding-related madness (Harano-prone; Royal Affliction). The line is dwindling. King Jonas Albrecht struggles to hold the tribes together against the rising Apocalypse.

entries.name: Tribe: Get of Fenris
entries.content:
**Tribe: Get of Fenris (totem: Fenris).** Norse-rooted berserkers, the Garou's strongest warriors.
- Starting Willpower 3.
- Believe Ragnarok is at hand and they will fight it.
- Sample tribal Gifts: Resist Pain · Smell of the True Form · Visceral Agony · Halt the Coward's Flight · Troll Skin.
- Cultural lean: strength, directness, warband solidarity. Complicit in the Bunyip slaughter.

entries.name: Tribe: Children of Gaia
entries.content:
**Tribe: Children of Gaia (totem: Unicorn).** Peacemakers, healers, inter-tribal mediators.
- Starting Willpower 4.
- Among the most balanced and inclusive tribes.
- Sample tribal Gifts: Mercy · Mother's Touch · Resist Pain · Calm · Strength of Purpose.
- Often dismissed as soft until needed — then refusal to compromise becomes iron. Active in Kinfolk relations and opposing Bunyip-era atrocities being repeated.

entries.name: Tribe: Glass Walkers
entries.content:
**Tribe: Glass Walkers (totem: Cockroach).** The urban tribe — tech-shamans, Weaver-navigators (without being corrupted by it).
- Starting Willpower 3.
- Run cities and corporate networks; sometimes mistrusted by wilderness tribes.
- Sample tribal Gifts: Control Simple Machine · Diagnostics · Plug & Play · Trick Shot · Cybersenses.
- Discouraged Background: Mentor.
- Some sub-camps embrace the Weaver too closely (fine line).

entries.name: Tribe: Red Talons
entries.content:
**Tribe: Red Talons (totem: Griffin).** LUPUS-ONLY tribe — no homid characters; metis rare and unwelcome.
- Starting Willpower 3.
- Most anti-human tribe — advocates the cull of humanity to save Gaia.
- Sample tribal Gifts: Beast Speech · Wolf at the Door · Scent of Running Water · Body Shift · Hidden Killer.
- Restricted Background: Resources. Discouraged: Allies · Contacts.
- Even other Garou often disagree with their solutions while respecting their conviction.

entries.name: Tribe: Bone Gnawers
entries.content:
**Tribe: Bone Gnawers (totem: Rat).** Keepers of the forgotten — urban-dwelling, the homeless and the dispossessed.
- Starting Willpower 4.
- Strongest grasp on what 'normal' humans suffer.
- Sample tribal Gifts: Cooking · Tagalong · Trash is Treasure · Scent of Sweet Honey · Resist Toxin.
- Restricted Backgrounds: Ancestors · Pure Breed. Discouraged: Resources.
- Lower-rank within the Garou Nation but with deep urban knowledge other tribes need.

entries.name: Tribe: Shadow Lords
entries.content:
**Tribe: Shadow Lords (totem: Grandfather Thunder).** Eastern European political manipulators.
- Starting Willpower 3.
- Ambitious, intelligent, suspicious of the Silver Fangs whose leadership they desire.
- Sample tribal Gifts: Aura of Confidence · Fatal Flaw · Seizing the Edge · Clap of Thunder · Strength of Purpose.
- Discouraged Backgrounds: Allies · Mentor.
- Other tribes distrust them; they accept this as part of leadership.

entries.name: Tribes: Uktena & Wendigo (the Pure Ones)
entries.content:
**Tribes: Uktena & Wendigo (the Pure Ones).**
- **Uktena** (totem: Uktena) — Americas-born occultists and Bane Tenders, keepers of dangerous lore. Starting Willpower 3. Bind the worst Banes rather than destroy them. Sample Gifts: Sense Magic · Spirit of the Bird · Sense the Unnatural.
- **Wendigo** (totem: Wendigo) — North American hunters, grim and traditionalist. Starting Willpower 4. Discouraged: Contacts, Resources.
- The two surviving Pure Ones tribes after the Croatan sacrificed themselves. Both deeply suspicious of European tribes for historical reasons.

entries.name: Rule: Character creation (W20)
entries.content:
**Rule: Character creation (W20).**
- **Concept**: Breed (Homid/Metis/Lupus), Auspice (5), Tribe (13).
- **Nature & Demeanour**: two Archetypes (Willpower-recovery condition + roleplay).
- **Attributes**: 7/5/3 priority across Physical / Social / Mental. All start at 1.
- **Abilities**: 13/9/5 priority across Talents/Skills/Knowledges. Lupus restrictions on Academics/Computer/Enigmas/Law/Technology (no dots at creation without justification).
- **Backgrounds**: 5 dots. Tribal restrictions apply.
- **Gifts**: one Level 1 each from Breed, Auspice, and Tribe lists.
- **Pools at creation**:
  - **Rage** by Auspice: Ragabash 1 · Theurge 2 · Philodox 3 · Galliard 4 · Ahroun 5
  - **Gnosis** by Breed: Homid 1 · Metis 3 · Lupus 5
  - **Willpower** by Tribe: 3 default · 4 for Bone Gnawers · Children of Gaia · Stargazers · Wendigo
- **Starting Renown** (3 permanent dots by Auspice, all at Rank 1 Cliath):
  - Ragabash: 3 in any category
  - Theurge: 3 Wisdom
  - Philodox: 3 Honour
  - Galliard: 2 Glory + 1 Wisdom
  - Ahroun: 2 Glory + 1 Honour
- **Freebie Points**: 15 base. Spend on Attributes (5/dot) · Abilities (2/dot) · Backgrounds (1/dot) · Gifts Lv1 (7/each) · Gnosis (2/dot) · Rage (1/dot) · Willpower (1/dot) · Renown (2/dot).
- **Merits/Flaws**: up to 7 points each. Flaws return up to 7 freebie points.
- **Specialties**: any Attribute/Ability 4+ may take a specialty (10s = 2 successes).
- **Pack creation**: coordinate concept, totem, territory, alpha, sept, allies/enemies with other players.

entries.name: Attribute: Strength (STR)
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary attribute. Strength (STR) [Physical] — Raw muscle. Lifting, melee damage, brawling pools. Modified by form (Glabro +2, Crinos +4, Hispo +3, Lupus +1).

entries.name: Attribute: Dexterity (DEX)
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary attribute. Dexterity (DEX) [Physical] — Agility, hand-eye coordination, attack accuracy, dodging. Modified by form (Crinos +1, Hispo +2, Lupus +2).

entries.name: Attribute: Stamina (STA)
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary attribute. Stamina (STA) [Physical] — Endurance, soak, resisting fatigue. Modified by form (Glabro +2, Crinos +3, Hispo +3, Lupus +2).

entries.name: Attribute: Charisma (CHA)
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary attribute. Charisma (CHA) [Social] — Force of personality, sincere charm, leadership presence.

entries.name: Attribute: Manipulation (MAN)
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary attribute. Manipulation (MAN) [Social] — Deceit, guile, indirect influence. Form penalties to humans (Glabro -2, Crinos -3, Hispo -3, Lupus -3); not vs. Garou or spirits.

entries.name: Attribute: Appearance (APP)
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary attribute. Appearance (APP) [Social] — Beauty / presence. Form penalties to humans (Glabro -1); Crinos APP becomes 0 to humans (Delirium); Hispo/Lupus do not use APP socially with humans.

entries.name: Attribute: Perception (PER)
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary attribute. Perception (PER) [Mental] — Spotting, hearing, noticing details. Hispo/Lupus get -1 to -2 reduction on Perception difficulties (sharper senses).

entries.name: Attribute: Intelligence (INT)
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary attribute. Intelligence (INT) [Mental] — Reasoning, learning, recall, abstract analysis.

entries.name: Attribute: Wits (WIT)
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary attribute. Wits (WIT) [Mental] — Reaction speed, on-the-fly thinking, initiative component.

entries.name: Skill: Alertness
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Alertness. Talent. Notice danger and details. Usable untrained.

entries.name: Skill: Athletics
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Athletics. Talent (W20). Climbing, running, jumping, swimming, dodging. Usable untrained.

entries.name: Skill: Brawl
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Brawl. Talent. Unarmed combat; punches, grapples, claw and bite strikes. Usable untrained.

entries.name: Skill: Empathy
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Empathy. Talent (W20). Read emotions, sense lies of the heart. Usable untrained.

entries.name: Skill: Expression
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Expression. Talent (W20). Communicating ideas, oratory, written prose, Garou tale-telling. Usable untrained.

entries.name: Skill: Intimidation
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Intimidation. Talent (W20). Threats, looming presence, breaking will. Usable untrained.

entries.name: Skill: Leadership
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Leadership. Talent (W20). Inspiring loyalty, giving orders, rallying a pack. Usable untrained.

entries.name: Skill: Primal-Urge
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Primal-Urge. Talent (W20-exclusive). The Garou's bestial instinct: form-shifting ease, predator's intuition, sensing the supernatural. Cannot be learned by non-Garou. Usable untrained.

entries.name: Skill: Streetwise
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Streetwise. Talent (W20). Navigating urban underbelly, contacts, fences, gossip. Usable untrained.

entries.name: Skill: Subterfuge
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Subterfuge. Talent (W20). Lying, misleading, deflecting questions. Usable untrained.

entries.name: Skill: Animal Ken
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Animal Ken. Skill. Handling and reading animals (other than wolves — Garou interpret pack-mates instinctively). Untrained: +1 difficulty.

entries.name: Skill: Crafts
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Crafts. Skill. Build, repair, and make physical things by hand. Untrained: +1 difficulty.

entries.name: Skill: Drive
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Drive. Skill. Operate vehicles under stress. Untrained: +1 difficulty.

entries.name: Skill: Etiquette
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Etiquette. Skill. Manners, protocol — both mortal society and Garou sept hierarchy. Untrained: +1 difficulty.

entries.name: Skill: Firearms
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Firearms. Skill. Handguns, rifles, automatic weapons. Untrained: +1 difficulty.

entries.name: Skill: Larceny
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Larceny. Skill. Lock-picking, sleight of hand, B&E, forgery. Untrained: +1 difficulty.

entries.name: Skill: Melee
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Melee. Skill. Armed close combat; blades, clubs, klaives, fetish weapons. Untrained: +1 difficulty.

entries.name: Skill: Performance
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Performance. Skill. Singing, instrument, acting, dance, story-telling for an audience. Untrained: +1 difficulty.

entries.name: Skill: Stealth
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Stealth. Skill. Move unseen and unheard. Untrained: +1 difficulty.

entries.name: Skill: Survival
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Survival. Skill. Wilderness travel, foraging, weather, tracking. Untrained: +1 difficulty.

entries.name: Skill: Academics
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Academics. Knowledge. History, literature, languages, the humanities. Untrained: cannot roll without source material.

entries.name: Skill: Computer
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Computer. Knowledge. Software, hardware, networks. Untrained: cannot roll.

entries.name: Skill: Enigmas
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Enigmas. Knowledge (W20-exclusive). Riddles, hidden patterns, spirit-logic. Theurges and Uktena excel. Untrained: cannot roll.

entries.name: Skill: Investigation
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Investigation. Knowledge. Forensic technique, evidence-handling, deduction. Untrained: cannot roll.

entries.name: Skill: Law
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Law. Knowledge. Statute, precedent, courtroom procedure — mortal law (the Litany lives in Rituals + Honour, not here). Untrained: cannot roll.

entries.name: Skill: Medicine
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Medicine. Knowledge. Diagnosis, surgery, pharmacology. Untrained: cannot roll.

entries.name: Skill: Occult
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Occult. Knowledge. Lore of the supernatural — vampires, mages, ghosts, the Wyrm. Untrained: cannot roll.

entries.name: Skill: Rituals
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Rituals. Knowledge (W20-exclusive). Knowledge of Garou rites. Sets the ceiling on what level of Rite a Garou may learn or perform: Rituals must equal or exceed the Rite's level. Untrained: cannot roll.

entries.name: Skill: Science
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Science. Knowledge. Physics, chemistry, biology — the natural sciences. Untrained: cannot roll.

entries.name: Skill: Technology
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary skill. Technology. Knowledge. Engineering, electronics, modern infrastructure. Untrained: cannot roll.

entries.name: Derived stat: Breed
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary derived stat. Breed — formula: Garou breed — Homid (raised human), Metis (born to two Garou; sterile; bears one Deformity Flaw), or Lupus (raised wolf). Set this manually on character creation; record the chosen breed in the character notes. Breed sets the Garou's starting Gnosis (Homid 1, Metis 3, Lupus 5) and unlocks the corresponding Breed Gift list. Default 1 = placeholder; treat as a text label rather than a numeric stat.

entries.name: Derived stat: Permanent Rage
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary derived stat. Permanent Rage — formula: The character's permanent Rage rating, 1-10. Starting value comes from Auspice: Ragabash 1, Theurge 2, Philodox 3, Galliard 4, Ahroun 5. This is the CAP on the Rage pool shown in the Resources cluster. Adjust this stepper directly when the character spends XP to raise Rage. Temporary Rage refreshes per moon-phase and other triggers (see lorebook).

entries.name: Derived stat: Permanent Gnosis
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary derived stat. Permanent Gnosis — formula: The character's permanent Gnosis rating, 1-10. Starting value comes from Breed: Homid 1, Metis 3, Lupus 5. CAP on the Gnosis pool. Spent on Gifts, Rites, Stepping Sideways into the Umbra. Each piece of silver carried subtracts 1 from effective Gnosis (one-day cooldown after dropping it).

entries.name: Derived stat: Permanent Willpower
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary derived stat. Permanent Willpower — formula: The character's permanent Willpower rating, 1-10. Tribe sets the starting value (3 for most tribes; 4 for Bone Gnawers, Children of Gaia, Stargazers, and Wendigo). CAP on the Willpower pool. Refresh: +1 on waking each day; full at end of a story (Storyteller discretion); +1 for fulfilling Nature; +1-3 for exceptional auspice duty.

entries.name: Derived stat: Permanent Glory
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary derived stat. Permanent Glory — formula: Permanent Glory Renown, 0-10. Reflects feats of strength, bravery, victory. Changes only through a Rite of Accomplishment (gain) or Punishment Rite (loss). Galliards and Ahroun favour Glory. See the temporary-Glory counter in Resources for accumulated deeds awaiting the next rite.

entries.name: Derived stat: Permanent Honour
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary derived stat. Permanent Honour — formula: Permanent Honour Renown, 0-10. Reflects duty, ethics, adherence to the Litany. Ragabash and Philodox favour Honour. Frenzying Garou who wake covered in blood usually lose Honour.

entries.name: Derived stat: Permanent Wisdom
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary derived stat. Permanent Wisdom — formula: Permanent Wisdom Renown, 0-10. Reflects thoughtful action, spirit-world insight, restraint. Theurges favour Wisdom.

entries.name: Derived stat: Rank
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary derived stat. Rank — formula: Garou social standing, 0-6. 0 Cub (pre-Rite of Passage), 1 Cliath (3 total Renown — earned at Rite of Passage), 2 Fostern (~6 total), 3 Adren (~12 total), 4 Athro (~18 total), 5 Elder (~25+ total), 6 Legend (rare; legendary heroes). A Garou cannot learn or use a Gift above their Rank. Ranks 3+ get +1 to +2 frenzy-resistance difficulty; Rank 5+ requires extra successes to enter frenzy.

entries.name: Derived stat: Health Track
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary derived stat. Health Track — formula: Seven levels (V20 baseline): Bruised(-0), Hurt(-1), Injured(-1), Wounded(-2), Mauled(-2), Crippled(-5), Incapacitated. Penalty in effect = the highest filled box. Bashing heals 1 level/turn automatically; Lethal 1 level/hour; Aggravated 1 level/day with rest. Silver damage is ALWAYS aggravated to Garou and bypasses regeneration. Garou cannot soak aggravated in their BREED form (Homid for Homids, Lupus for Lupus, Crinos for Metis); other forms soak aggravated with Stamina at difficulty 6.

entries.name: Derived stat: Initiative
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary derived stat. Initiative — formula: {Dexterity} + {Wits}

entries.name: Derived stat: Brawl Attack
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary derived stat. Brawl Attack — formula: {Dexterity} + {Brawl}

entries.name: Derived stat: Melee Attack
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary derived stat. Melee Attack — formula: {Dexterity} + {Melee}

entries.name: Derived stat: Firearms Attack
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary derived stat. Firearms Attack — formula: {Dexterity} + {Firearms}

entries.name: Derived stat: Soak (Bashing)
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary derived stat. Soak (Bashing) — formula: {Stamina} + {bonuses:Soak (Bashing)}

entries.name: Derived stat: Soak (Lethal)
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary derived stat. Soak (Lethal) — formula: {Stamina} + {bonuses:Soak (Lethal)}

entries.name: Derived stat: Soak (Aggravated)
entries.content: Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary derived stat. Soak (Aggravated) — formula: {Stamina} + {bonuses:Soak (Aggravated)}

entries.name: Difficulty ladder reference
entries.content:
Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary difficulty ladder. Threshold values needed for success:
- Trivial (threshold 4) — Trivial for a competent character. Often waived.
- Routine (threshold 5) — Routine task; minor pressure.
- Standard (threshold 6) — W20 default. Average task under normal conditions.
- Challenging (threshold 7) — Pushes a competent Garou; pressure or distraction.
- Difficult (threshold 8) — Few succeed without bonuses or supernatural help.
- Nigh-Impossible (threshold 9) — Heroic; requires Willpower, Gifts, or aid.

customTools.name: w20_reference
customTools.description: Returns canonical Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary reference: dice, resolution, difficulty ladder, attributes, skills. Call when the GM needs authoritative ruleset detail mid-narration.
customTools.staticResult:
# Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary — canonical reference

Storyteller-system d10 dice pool on the V20 chassis. Pool = Attribute + Ability. Each die meeting or beating the difficulty (default 6, range 6-9) is one success. A 1 subtracts one success. Botch on a roll showing zero successes AND at least one 1. Specialty 10s reroll. Three pools: Rage (frenzy + extra actions + form-shift), Gnosis (Gifts + Rites + Stepping Sideways), Willpower (auto-success + resisting urges). Renown (Glory/Honour/Wisdom) determines Rank. Five forms (Homid/Glabro/Crinos/Hispo/Lupus) modify Physical and Social Attributes.

## Dice
- Type: `d10`
- Notation: `Xd10 vs <difficulty>`

## Resolution
- Mode: `dice-pool`
- Pool formula: Attribute + Ability (+ specialty 10-rerolls when applicable, + Willpower auto-success once/turn, + Gift dice, + Rage extra-action dice). Wound penalty subtracts from pools.
- Default target: 6

## Difficulty ladder
- **Trivial** (threshold 4) — Trivial for a competent character. Often waived.
- **Routine** (threshold 5) — Routine task; minor pressure.
- **Standard** (threshold 6) — W20 default. Average task under normal conditions.
- **Challenging** (threshold 7) — Pushes a competent Garou; pressure or distraction.
- **Difficult** (threshold 8) — Few succeed without bonuses or supernatural help.
- **Nigh-Impossible** (threshold 9) — Heroic; requires Willpower, Gifts, or aid.

## Attributes
- **Strength** (STR) [Physical] — Raw muscle. Lifting, melee damage, brawling pools. Modified by form (Glabro +2, Crinos +4, Hispo +3, Lupus +1).
- **Dexterity** (DEX) [Physical] — Agility, hand-eye coordination, attack accuracy, dodging. Modified by form (Crinos +1, Hispo +2, Lupus +2).
- **Stamina** (STA) [Physical] — Endurance, soak, resisting fatigue. Modified by form (Glabro +2, Crinos +3, Hispo +3, Lupus +2).
- **Charisma** (CHA) [Social] — Force of personality, sincere charm, leadership presence.
- **Manipulation** (MAN) [Social] — Deceit, guile, indirect influence. Form penalties to humans (Glabro -2, Crinos -3, Hispo -3, Lupus -3); not vs. Garou or spirits.
- **Appearance** (APP) [Social] — Beauty / presence. Form penalties to humans (Glabro -1); Crinos APP becomes 0 to humans (Delirium); Hispo/Lupus do not use APP socially with humans.
- **Perception** (PER) [Mental] — Spotting, hearing, noticing details. Hispo/Lupus get -1 to -2 reduction on Perception difficulties (sharper senses).
- **Intelligence** (INT) [Mental] — Reasoning, learning, recall, abstract analysis.
- **Wits** (WIT) [Mental] — Reaction speed, on-the-fly thinking, initiative component.

## Skills
- **Alertness** — Talent. Notice danger and details. Usable untrained.
- **Athletics** — Talent (W20). Climbing, running, jumping, swimming, dodging. Usable untrained.
- **Brawl** — Talent. Unarmed combat; punches, grapples, claw and bite strikes. Usable untrained.
- **Empathy** — Talent (W20). Read emotions, sense lies of the heart. Usable untrained.
- **Expression** — Talent (W20). Communicating ideas, oratory, written prose, Garou tale-telling. Usable untrained.
- **Intimidation** — Talent (W20). Threats, looming presence, breaking will. Usable untrained.
- **Leadership** — Talent (W20). Inspiring loyalty, giving orders, rallying a pack. Usable untrained.
- **Primal-Urge** — Talent (W20-exclusive). The Garou's bestial instinct: form-shifting ease, predator's intuition, sensing the supernatural. Cannot be learned by non-Garou. Usable untrained.
- **Streetwise** — Talent (W20). Navigating urban underbelly, contacts, fences, gossip. Usable untrained.
- **Subterfuge** — Talent (W20). Lying, misleading, deflecting questions. Usable untrained.
- **Animal Ken** — Skill. Handling and reading animals (other than wolves — Garou interpret pack-mates instinctively). Untrained: +1 difficulty.
- **Crafts** — Skill. Build, repair, and make physical things by hand. Untrained: +1 difficulty.
- **Drive** — Skill. Operate vehicles under stress. Untrained: +1 difficulty.
- **Etiquette** — Skill. Manners, protocol — both mortal society and Garou sept hierarchy. Untrained: +1 difficulty.
- **Firearms** — Skill. Handguns, rifles, automatic weapons. Untrained: +1 difficulty.
- **Larceny** — Skill. Lock-picking, sleight of hand, B&E, forgery. Untrained: +1 difficulty.
- **Melee** — Skill. Armed close combat; blades, clubs, klaives, fetish weapons. Untrained: +1 difficulty.
- **Performance** — Skill. Singing, instrument, acting, dance, story-telling for an audience. Untrained: +1 difficulty.
- **Stealth** — Skill. Move unseen and unheard. Untrained: +1 difficulty.
- **Survival** — Skill. Wilderness travel, foraging, weather, tracking. Untrained: +1 difficulty.
- **Academics** — Knowledge. History, literature, languages, the humanities. Untrained: cannot roll without source material.
- **Computer** — Knowledge. Software, hardware, networks. Untrained: cannot roll.
- **Enigmas** — Knowledge (W20-exclusive). Riddles, hidden patterns, spirit-logic. Theurges and Uktena excel. Untrained: cannot roll.
- **Investigation** — Knowledge. Forensic technique, evidence-handling, deduction. Untrained: cannot roll.
- **Law** — Knowledge. Statute, precedent, courtroom procedure — mortal law (the Litany lives in Rituals + Honour, not here). Untrained: cannot roll.
- **Medicine** — Knowledge. Diagnosis, surgery, pharmacology. Untrained: cannot roll.
- **Occult** — Knowledge. Lore of the supernatural — vampires, mages, ghosts, the Wyrm. Untrained: cannot roll.
- **Rituals** — Knowledge (W20-exclusive). Knowledge of Garou rites. Sets the ceiling on what level of Rite a Garou may learn or perform: Rituals must equal or exceed the Rite's level. Untrained: cannot roll.
- **Science** — Knowledge. Physics, chemistry, biology — the natural sciences. Untrained: cannot roll.
- **Technology** — Knowledge. Engineering, electronics, modern infrastructure. Untrained: cannot roll.

This chat uses the Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary ruleset overlay.

Storyteller-system d10 dice pool on the V20 chassis. Pool = Attribute + Ability. Each die meeting or beating the difficulty (default 6, range 6-9) is one success. A 1 subtracts one success. Botch on a roll showing zero successes AND at least one 1. Specialty 10s reroll. Three pools: Rage (frenzy + extra actions + form-shift), Gnosis (Gifts + Rites + Stepping Sideways), Willpower (auto-success + resisting urges). Renown (Glory/Honour/Wisdom) determines Rank. Five forms (Homid/Glabro/Crinos/Hispo/Lupus) modify Physical and Social Attributes.

Mechanics: primary die d10, notation Xd10 vs <difficulty>.
Resolution: dice-pool.

The GM should keep narration consistent with Werewolf: The Apocalypse 20th Anniversary mechanics. Refer to the lorebook entries for ruleset reference.
